record.name: MELD Score
record.review_note: Estimates 3-month mortality in chronic liver disease. UNITS: this formula uses mg/dL, but South African labs report bilirubin and creatinine in µmol/L — convert first: bilirubin mg/dL = µmol/L ÷ 17.1; creatinine mg/dL = µmol/L ÷ 88.4. Lab values below 1.0 are floored to 1.0; creatinine is capped at 4.0 (forced to 4.0 if the patient has had dialysis twice in the past week); the final score is rounded and clamped to the standard 6-40 reporting range.
